en.html:
Four in the morning.

We chose the hour when sleep was deepest and began.

The route to avoid patrols had already been checked. From one narrow blind spot of the watchtowers to the next, we moved through the dark.

...Honestly, there were doubts. Overthinking, probably. I would like to believe that.

The Noh performance. That public warning. How much had it been intended to say? And that peculiar man's look...

Each time I considered it, the suspicion grew. Postponing the operation, however, was not an option.

午前四時。
　最も眠りの深い時刻を見計らい、行動を開始した。

　警邏隊と出くわさぬ道順は事前に調査済み。
　物見櫓のわずかな死角から死角をつき、夜陰の中を
潜行する。

　……正直、懸念はあった。
　考え過ぎであろうとは思う――が。

　あの能舞台。あの<ruby>見せしめ<rt>・・・・</rt></ruby>には、果たしてどこまで
の意味があったのか。
　そしてあの奇態な男の視線……。

　思う都度、疑惑は増す。
　だがそれでも、延期は論外と考えざるを得なかった。

en.html:
Ichijou could no longer be stopped. If I spent time investigating, she would go by herself while I was busy.

That meant leaving her to die. Straight ahead was the only direction this girl recognised. An operation left to her impulse was hardly going to succeed.

Pile up the bodies, then fall on top herself. For nothing.

No. That could not be allowed. Preventing precisely such a pointless heap of dead was why I was accompanying her.

Delay I had given up on. But her proposed change—to ambush and kill Doushin Yusa—I had somehow talked her out of. No prospect of success, I explained.

...Success should not have been the deciding point. I ought to stop it regardless.

But suppose even a small chance existed. How sincerely would I have stopped her then? My own answer was not available.

一条を制止するのはもはや、無理だ。
　俺が調査に時間を費やせば、その間に単独で行動を
起こすだろう。

　それでは見殺しになる。
　この直進しか知らぬ少女の意に任せて、事が成ると
は思えない。

　屍の山を築いた挙句、その頂点へ伏せるだろうか。
　意味もなく。

　そうはさせられなかった。
　無意味な死屍累々の結末など迎えさせぬために、俺
が同行しているのだ。

　行動の延期は諦めたが、一条が望んだ作戦変更――
遊佐童心の襲殺――はどうにか説き伏せて断念させた。
　成功の見込みが無いと<ruby>諭<rt>さと</rt></ruby>して。

　……見込み云々とは関係なく、それは止めねばなら
ぬところであろうが。
　もし万一にも成功が望めたなら、俺もどこまで本気
で一条を制止したか。我ながら不明であった。

en.html:
Muramasa's concealment was excellent, naturally. Masamune also apparently needed only darkness and a little cover to vanish completely. Ordinary human eyes, of course, would miss them.

A small omission from my side. With quite large possible consequences. Had Madam Iwata screamed, we would already be running away, before doing a single thing.

Congratulations, Kageaki. So well hidden were your weapons that you nearly defeated your own guide. The enemy need not participate. We could arrange the surprise, sound the alarm, and flee from ourselves. Full service. Bas, next time warn the person who is supposed to be helping.

en.html:
During the planning, I had told her we were bringing tsurugi. Apparently two rare old-style suits had not been what she imagined. She stared at them as though belief was taking some effort.

Keeping that detail until the last moment was deliberate. For the dramatic effect.

Let her see what armed strength the Prince's side possessed. That impression would certainly count in our future dealings with Raichou Imagawa.

の品だとは考えてもみなかったようだ。
　信じ難いという面持ちで二領の劒冑を眺めている。

　この事を最初から教えず、土壇場まで伏せておいた
のは、つまり<ruby>演出効果<rt>・・・・</rt></ruby>を狙ったからである。

は今川雷蝶との今後の関係において必ず影響しよう。

Iwata"...Let us proceed. Ayane ji behind me. Minato ji, please take the rear."
Kageaki"Understood."
Ichijou"How are we getting in? You're supposed to be showing the way, I heard."
Iwata"Through the back entrance used by the inner servants. Normally it is locked at night. I have arranged for it to remain open tonight."
Iwata"Once inside, the rest is not difficult."
Ichijou"Achha. ...Minato sir. When do we armour up?"
Kageaki"Immediately before infiltration becomes attack. Not yet."
Kageaki"The moment we armour, at least every warrior guarding the main keep will probably notice and rush us. Till the last possible instant, we must wait."
Ichijou"Understood."

On the ground, especially indoors, a warrior's radar was mostly decoration. Heat detection, however, still worked.

The range was not large. But an unidentified unit appearing in the same building was hardly going to escape notice.

The dragoons already active should respond immediately. Possibly from farther away as well. The latest walker dragoons were said to have heat detection far stronger than anything in the older models...

Iwata"Speed is everything in this operation. Once you judge the objective sufficiently achieved, withdraw immediately."
Iwata"If they close the surrounding airspace, it is over. Whatever happens, get outside the castle before that."
Kageaki"Understood."
Ichijou"And you?"
Iwata"An attack on His Highness Kuniuji, and the new Mandokoro recruit disappears at the same time. The connection will be plain. Since I introduced that recruit, questioning is unavoidable for me also. So..."
Iwata"Once I have shown you the way, I shall leave directly. No need to worry."
Ichijou"Worried? Main tumhari nurse nahin. I'm not getting stuck looking after you also, Rokuhara. That was my concern."
Iwata"...Oh? Is that so."
Kageaki(Muramasa. Surroundings?)
Muramasa《Nothing unusual. Not the same thing as peace and safety, obviously.》
Muramasa《Security is as tight as ever. But with somebody who knows the inside guiding us, we should get through...》
Muramasa《Unless that longhorn beetle makes himself our luggage.》
Masamune《Say what you wish, spider. Unlike a lawless creature such as yourself, I find no shame in being unsuited to skulking in darkness.》
Muramasa《...¦ Achha ji. A whole performance defect, and not one gram of shame. You are a tsurugi, or an apology for one? But of course, the nation's finest has room in his greatness for anything.》
Masamune《...》
Muramasa《...》
